title: Approve league outreach email batch 1
body:
## Approval Needed: Send 6 Outreach Emails to Basketball Associations

**What:** Send personalized HTML emails to 6 Australian basketball associations offering a free SubTracker pilot.

**Recipients:**
1. Basketball NSW — info@bnsw.com.au
2. Basketball Victoria (enquiries) — enquiries@basketballvictoria.com.au
3. Basketball Victoria (coaching) — coaching@basketballvictoria.com.au
4. Basketball Queensland — admin@basketballqld.net.au; coachdev@basketballqld.net.au
5. Wyndham Basketball — rep@wyndhambasketball.com
6. Banyule Hawks — info@banyulehawks.com.au

**Offer:** Free pilot — unlimited teams for the season, zero setup.

**Assets:**
- Email template: `marketing/email-template-outreach-1.html`
- Personalized batch: `marketing/ready-to-send-batch-1.md`
- Full sequence: `marketing/outreach-email-sequence.md`

**Risk:** Low. Highly targeted, personalized, value-first messaging. 2 follow-ups max with clear opt-out.

**Full details:** `issues/approval-request-league-email-batch-1.md`
